### Top Nonprofit CRMs with Integrated Donation Forms

Several nonprofit CRMs stand out from the search results for combining donor management with seamless, mobile-friendly donation forms. These tools automate gift tracking, donor data syncing, and relationship building, often boosting conversion rates (e.g., up to 3x averages). Here's a breakdown of the strongest matches, prioritized by frequency of mentions and feature depth:

#### 1. **DonorPerfect** (Most Comprehensive for Forms + CRM)
   - **Key Features**: High-converting online forms for one-time, recurring, and tribute gifts. Forms auto-populate donor records in the CRM for instant acknowledgment, reporting, and thank-yous. Mobile-optimized; handles mass mailings and moves management.
   - **Evidence**: Every plan includes forms that flow data directly into CRM ([1], [2]). Integrates with matching gifts via Double the Donation ([4]).
   - **Best For**: Nonprofits focused on donor retention and admin efficiency.
   - **Site**: [donorperfect.com](https://www.donorperfect.com)

#### 2. **Funraise** (All-in-One Fundraising + CRM)
   - **Key Features**: Custom online donation forms with donor profiles, engagement tracking, campaign management, and email tools. Forms integrate with CRM for donation history, segmentation, and analytics. Supports peer-to-peer and events.
   - **Evidence**: Provides "top-of-the-line fundraising tools" like forms alongside CRM; auto-syncs data for insights ([3]). Matching gift integration ([4]).
   - **Best For**: Growing orgs needing intuitive donor lifecycle management.
   - **Site**: [funraise.org](https://www.funraise.org/features/donor-crm)

#### 3. **Givebutter** (Free, Modern All-in-One)
   - **Key Features**: Built-in donation forms (convert 47% of visitors) with donor management, engagement tracking, and comms. Unlimited contacts; auto-syncs gifts to CRM. Includes events and peer-to-peer.
   - **Evidence**: Full fundraising suite with CRM; forms collect employment data for matching gifts ([4], [8], [10]).
   - **Best For**: Small teams or budgets (free tier available).
   - **Site**: [givebutter.com](https://givebutter.com)

#### 4. **CauseVox** (CRM-Focused with Easy Forms)
   - **Key Features**: Customizable, mobile-friendly donation pages that auto-sync to CRM for giving history, segmentation, and outreach tracking. Includes donor self-service portal and task management.
   - **Evidence**: Forms handle transactions while CRM tracks relationships; no manual uploads needed ([5]).
   - **Best For**: Small teams emphasizing donor journeys.
   - **Site**: [causevox.com](https://www.causevox.com/blog/crm-software-for-nonprofits/)

#### Other Strong Options with Forms + CRM
| CRM          | Standout Form/CRM Integration                  | Matching Gifts? | Source |
|--------------|------------------------------------------------|-----------------|--------|
| **Donorbox** | AI-powered CRM with donate buttons/forms; email & segmentation | Not specified  | [6]   |
| **Bloomerang** | Fundraising tools + CRM for donors/volunteers | Not specified | [7]   |
| **Keela**    | Forms sync to CRM; auto-matching prompts      | Yes ([4])     | [4]   |
| **Neon CRM** | Comprehensive donor system; seamless data flow| Yes ([4])     | [4]   |

**Quick Comparison**:
- **Ease of Use**: Givebutter and Funraise for beginners; DonorPerfect for scale.
- **Integrations**: Most (e.g., DonorPerfect, Funraise, Givebutter) pair with Double the Donation for matching gifts, auto-screening donors post-form submission.
- **Pricing**: Givebutter offers free plans; others vary (e.g., DonorPerfect starts with forms in all tiers).

These CRMs shift from transactional giving to relationship-building by ensuring every form submission updates donor profiles instantly. For trials, start with DonorPerfect or Givebutter demos. If you need specifics (e.g., pricing, setup), provide more details!
